correctness.rationale: For characteristic-two cubic F, Euler identity gives F=XF_X+YF_Y+ZF_Z. Geometric smoothness equals absence of projective zero of three quadratic partials, equivalently rank 15 of their Macaulay degree-four multiplication map (a regular sequence). There are 336 smooth masks among 1023; binary pencil is a triple {a,b,a xor b}, enumerating all [10 choose 2]_2=174251 subspaces. Complete exact filtering yields 5544 all-smooth and 2016 rational-basepoint-free pencils. PGL3(F2) order 168 acts by exact polynomial substitutions, giving 12 free orbits. Every containing all-smooth net contributes exactly four outside coset representatives, producing extension counts 504,840,672. Seven rational points and lines yield the stated 672/1344 blocking split. The finite proof domain is complete, not an extrapolation from extension-field point sampling. The same 336/5544/2016/12/504/840/672 already occur in a verified earlier full census.
